narrative:
Barberton municipal court district has 74,474 registered voters, with 55.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 20.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 23.4%, a modest Democratic lean of 2.6 percentage points. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +2.5% D−R vs +0.6% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
